trello.name: Implement Frontend Checkout and Pricing Page
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Within 2 weeks. Implement Stripe Elements checkout form matching app design, including error handling for invalid cards/insufficient funds. Update the pricing page to reflect Basic ($29), Pro ($49), and Enterprise ($99) tiers with clear feature comparisons. Include a tooltip/help icon explaining plan changes. Ensure the checkout button is prominent and the design is clean and straightforward.

trello.name: Implement User Dashboard Subscription Management
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Within 2 weeks. Build the user dashboard to display current plan details, billing info, invoices, and payment history. Implement options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscriptions. Add functionality to update payment methods. Ensure real-time reflection of subscription status and notify users of changes (e.g., successful upgrades, payment failures). Handle errors clearly with user-friendly notifications and instructions.

trello.name: Integrate Backend Stripe API and Webhooks
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Within 2 weeks. Integrate Stripe API to handle creating/managing subscriptions and processing payments. Set up webhook handlers for 'invoice.payment_succeeded' (activate/continue subscription), 'invoice.payment_failed' (notify user, prompt update, send email), and 'customer.subscription.deleted' (update access rights, offer re-subscribe). Ensure webhooks update the system correctly.

trello.name: Create and Execute Subscription Test Plan
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor (with Jordan). Deadline: 1 week after initial integration (by end of 3rd week). Prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow (sign-up, billing, management). Simulate events like payment failures and cancellations. Ensure all edge cases are covered and functionality is verified. Share the test plan with the team.

trello.name: Develop User Documentation and Support Materials
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan and Taylor. Deadline: Before launch. Jordan: Create a help section/FAQ covering common subscription issues and questions. Taylor: Document API endpoints and webhook event handlers for maintenance and troubleshooting. Provide clear instructions for users on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and handling issues.

trello.name: Schedule and Conduct Follow-up Meeting
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Deadline: Next week. Schedule a follow-up meeting to review progress, address issues, and discuss blockers. Ensure open communication for support needs.
